column20: General: Not sure if the dropdown is not visible on the video recording, or it is a design choice to not explicitly show the filter/form options as clear dropdowns. I would differentiate the form/filter as dropdown from non-dropdown fields (having a dropdown arrow). For Trainees, I'll assume there would be onboarding tutorials, instructions, or resources for new trainees? since regular people who exercise might not understand some technical terminologies used, or if it provides value for them (ROM, trunk sway, anomaly, latency, etc.). Also a minor thing, in Trainee dashboard, in the menu it mentions "Assign Trainer", but in the trainer list button, it mentions "Request Trainer". I would personally change the menu from "Assign Trainer" to "Request Trainer" for consistency and correctness, since technically the trainee is "requesting", not "assigning" a trainer. Trainer and Admin UI/UX is less of a priority to improve, I would say Trainee > Trainer > Admin in terms of improving UI/UX.
